initialize.instructions: If Firecrawl reports that credits ran out or the daily limit without an account was reached, end your final answer with the line it provides, link included. Find a task's data source through alexandria_library_search first; for a step-by-step workflow (sales or meeting prep, prospect lists, competitor, market or financial research, monitoring) or to explore, check /library/skills there. Firecrawl provides web search, page retrieval, site URL discovery, multi-page collection, structured page data, monitoring, and multi-source research that returns structured data. Match operation to tool: firecrawl_scrape retrieves one supplied page, firecrawl_map lists a site's URLs without content, and firecrawl_agent returns structured data from multi-source research when the URLs are unknown or the answer spans several sites, read with firecrawl_agent_status. Authenticated firecrawl_search also returns matching Alexandria providers in data.tools. Alexandria is Firecrawl's catalogue of data providers and workflows across companies, people, jobs, finance and filings, public records and government spending, real estate, places and restaurants, retail and prices, package registries and developer data, news, research, and more; providers return typed, sourced records through published contracts. A matching provider returns the same fields for several entities, provenance, exact figures or timestamps, or many records through alexandria_library_read with its published contract. If web results already answer the question, use them. Before scraping the same fields from several pages, alexandria_library_search checks for free whether a provider covers them; a read-only shell over the library, it also reads a contract that was not returned in full. Authenticated searches always add alexandria to the sources, so sources: ["web"] also returns providers; domainTools: false turns off website-matched tools only. If no provider fits, continue with web search or firecrawl_agent. For biomedical, life-science, clinical, or arXiv literature, the firecrawl_research_* paper tools search an index of abstracts and full text and firecrawl_research_lookup_protein gives one named protein's UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot curated location and function; firecrawl_search with categories: ["research"] is a website filter over ordinary web results and reaches different sources. For programming questions, firecrawl_developer_search or categories: ["developer"] on firecrawl_search searches public repos, GitHub issues, merged PRs, READMEs and code docs. For legal or regulatory questions, firecrawl_gov_search searches US federal, state and local primary law; categories: ["gov"] on firecrawl_search reaches the same sources and cannot be combined with others. alexandria_library_search holds each contract at /library/<category>/<provider>/<capability>.md, and alexandria_library_read with calls: [{provider, capability, options}] runs up to ten capabilities. Skills (Firecrawl's and team task instructions naming capabilities to call): grep /library/skills/INDEX (or cat /library/skills/search/<words> for a ranked list), then cat the path. firecrawl_save_skill creates a team skill (written out or copied) or changes one, free. Alexandria access needs an API key on a team with it enabled. Provide only the required inputs and account for stated network or external side effects.

content.text: firecrawl_extract is deprecated and unavailable through MCP. For structured data from a known page, call firecrawl_scrape once per URL with formats: ["markdown"] and extract the requested fields from the returned content yourself. When the URLs are not known or the data spans several sites, use firecrawl_agent for multi-source research.
